steps.label: Skripte schreiben (Vitrine ohne Frontglas, dunklerer Saal)

steps.run: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P hero.py -- save > save.log 2>&1; grep -v -i -e bearer -e api_key save.log | grep -e HERO -e rror | tail -5; ls -la hero.blend
steps.label: Blender baut die Sets neu

steps.run: [ -f hero.blend ] || exit 1; mkdir -p r; T=$(date +%s); bash "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/par_render.sh" 2 0 99 -- /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b hero.blend -P hero.py -- render {S} {E}; bash "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/par_render.sh" 2 200 274 -- /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b hero.blend -P hero.py -- render {S} {E}; ls r | wc -l; echo render_s $(( $(date +%s)-T ))
steps.label: Blender rendert Vitrine + leere Vitrine neu (175 Bilder, 16 Samples, 2 Prozesse)

steps.run: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b hero.blend -P hero.py -- encode > enc.log 2>&1; grep -e ENC -e SHEET -e rror enc.log | tail; ls -la *.mp4 sheet.png
steps.label: MP4 kodieren + Kontaktbogen
